source: Roadside weighbridge / portable axle-load spot-survey dataset
method: Portable weighbridge spot counts by station: average daily traffic volume, average gross vehicle weight, percentage of vehicles exceeding legal axle load limits, and derived ESAL (equivalent standard axle load) factor per survey station.
note: Distinct from the Weighbridge Survey Register above (permanent weighbridge station data). This is a separate spot-check survey dataset. Vehicle-class breakdown is not available in this dataset — all records are reported as a single combined 'Mixed Fleet' category by the source survey, so class-specific axle-load figures cannot be derived from it. Road name/region/class joined from the national network register by road number where matched.
vehicle_class_note: All records use a single combined class ('Mixed Fleet'); no per-class axle-load breakdown is available in this dataset.
